        ///     Registers the scoped <see cref="KeryxMediator" /> (one instance per scope), <see cref="global::Keryx.IMediator" />,
        ///     <see cref="global::Keryx.ISender" /> and <see cref="global::Keryx.IPublisher" /> as transient factories that return that
        ///     instance, and every handler class that has injected parameters, scoped, all with generated factories. Behaviors are static and
        ///     are not registered.
        ///     Registrations that already exist are kept, so a second call does nothing.
        /// </summary>
        /// <param name="services">The service collection.</param>
        /// <returns>The same service collection.</returns>
        public static global::Microsoft.Extensions.DependencyInjection.IServiceCollection AddKeryx(this global::Microsoft.Extensions.DependencyInjection.IServiceCollection services)
        {
            global::System.ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(services);
            global::Microsoft.Extensions.DependencyInjection.Extensions.ServiceCollectionDescriptorExtensions.TryAddScoped(services, static serviceProvider => new KeryxMediator(serviceProvider));
            global::Microsoft.Extensions.DependencyInjection.Extensions.ServiceCollectionDescriptorExtensions.TryAddTransient<global::Keryx.IMediator>(services, static serviceProvider => global::Microsoft.Extensions.DependencyInjection.ServiceProviderServiceExtensions.GetRequiredService<KeryxMediator>(serviceProvider));
            global::Microsoft.Extensions.DependencyInjection.Extensions.ServiceCollectionDescriptorExtensions.TryAddTransient<global::Keryx.ISender>(services, static serviceProvider => global::Microsoft.Extensions.DependencyInjection.ServiceProviderServiceExtensions.GetRequiredService<KeryxMediator>(serviceProvider));
            global::Microsoft.Extensions.DependencyInjection.Extensions.ServiceCollectionDescriptorExtensions.TryAddTransient<global::Keryx.IPublisher>(services, static serviceProvider => global::Microsoft.Extensions.DependencyInjection.ServiceProviderServiceExtensions.GetRequiredService<KeryxMediator>(serviceProvider));
            return services;
        }
    }
}
